links.outcome: LLM diet and exercise recommendations compliance with AHA/ACC and ESC guidelines
links.effect: 90% of responses from ChatGPT, Claude AI, and DeepSeek AI met guideline standards; Gemini 80%; all models struggled with precise quantitative carbohydrate and added sugar guidance.
links.quote: Ninety percent of responses from ChatGPT, Claude AI, and DeepSeek AI met established cardiovascular health standards, indicating superior performance among the language models.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the accuracy and adherence of several commercial LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Gemini) to cardiology guidelines for diet and exercise advice via expert scoring of standardized questions, but does not test a deployment practice or safeguard.
